extracted.name: Finnish-Style Mojakka
extracted.description: This mojakka soup recipe is a staple in any Finnish household. Serve this flavorful beef and vegetable soup with flatbread (leipa).
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook beef in hot butter until browned on all sides. Pour in 4 cups water and bring to a boil. Add onion, salt, and pepper. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Add potatoes, carrots, and celery; simmer for 1 1/2 more hours.
Whisk together remaining 1/2 cup water and flour in a small bowl to form a thin paste; stir into soup and simmer until thickened, about 15 minutes.
